hints: push_front: the new node's next is the old head, and the new node becomes the head.
push_back: handle the empty list separately. Otherwise walk to the last node (or keep a tail pointer) and attach there.
reverse: walk the list with three variables: prev, node and the saved node.next. If you keep a tail pointer, update it too.
